verdict.rationale: Raygun ships a built-in AI Error Resolution chat. It is powered by OpenAI or Azure OpenAI and auto-prompts the LLM with stack trace, environment and code context. It offers root-cause and fix suggestions, collaborative chat, and links that post a conversation into error comments. However, it is scoped to advising on individual errors rather than carrying out delegated tasks, and the docs indicate you must supply your own OpenAI API key. Missing for 10: evidence of the assistant taking actions or executing delegated tasks beyond suggestions, AI help across other product areas such as APM and RUM, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
